decision.name: P0_FINAL_WRITER_COHERENCE_NOT_READER_SNAPSHOT_ATOMICITY
decision.finding: Pinned P0 two-writer regression checks only the three persisted as_of_ms values after both writers finish. Exact runner.py independently replaces latest.json, audit_latest.json and anata_latest.json in sequence; atomic_write_json is per-file. Even a future writer serialization fix and a green P0 final-state test do not establish that a reader combining these files cannot observe mixed generations mid-publication.
decision.scope: Coverage/acceptance distinction, not an independently demonstrated consumer bug: no cross-file reader contract verified. Do not claim multi-file atomic visibility or expand P0 PASS into reader-snapshot proof.
decision.recovery_contract: On authorized exact-SHA disposable checkout, first run unchanged Capital Flow baseline and pinned P0/P1 overlays. Separately identify the supported consumer read path: if it combines these files, stage T0 outputs, gate a T1 writer immediately after latest.json replacement, invoke the real reader while writer is paused, require a coherent single generation or explicit incomplete-snapshot rejection, then release writer and verify final T1. If consumers read only one file, document that narrower guarantee and do not add a speculative cross-file acceptance test.
decision.priority: Existing unexecuted P0 publication/coherence and P1 non-skipped POSIX archive admission tests remain first. No additional speculative test file or Specialist edits.
